phase_name: Add Check L and its fixture coverage

objectives.description: Implement check_l_modified_files_bullet in lint-agent-contracts.sh; fix the wrapped track-on-write line in all 13 Phase 2-4 agent files to a single physical line so Check L's runtime extraction matches
Fixture repair and Check L assertions in test-lint-agent-contracts.sh

approaches_tried.approach: Initial track-on-write insertion wrapped across multiple physical lines for readability in all 13 Phase 2-4 agent files
approaches_tried.reason: grep -F cannot match a literal string across an embedded newline, so Check L's runtime extraction of the canonical track-on-write line never matched any of the 13 files despite the earlier phase verifications appearing to pass (those checks used a truncated prefix anchor that only spanned the first wrapped line). Fixed by collapsing the line to a single physical line in all 13 files before implementing Check L.
